name: Daily Payment Summary column drawer exposes all default switches
description:
1. Sign in and open Daily Payment Summary.
2. Open Customize Columns.
3. Confirm each configured switch is visible and checked by default.
4. Confirm Apply is disabled until a change is made, then close the drawer.
